_comment: Video settings: the Video section of the game menu's Settings (doc 23) and frame pacing
(doc 21). Source of truth for VideoSettings.gd. The settings are listed in the order the
page shows them. Each default is what the game does unaided, so nothing changes until
the player chooses; the player's choices live in user://video.cfg, for every colony.
display: borderless is the project's own full screen; fullscreen is exclusive full
screen; windowed opens at window_screen_share of the screen, centred, and keeps its size.
render_scale: below 1 the world is drawn smaller and FSR 1 upscales it; the interface
keeps the screen's full size.
frame_rate: the choices are the even shares of the screen's refresh rate (the refresh
rate divided by 1, 2 ... shares) down to lowest. The cap is the largest share not above
the chosen rate, so every frame stays on screen equally long; the default 75 gives 60
at 120 Hz, 72 at 144 Hz and 60 at 60 Hz.
shadows: the shadow atlas sizes and the soft filter (0 hard, 1 soft very low, 2 soft
low); high is the engine's own.
anti_aliasing: MSAA samples (0, 2 or 4) and SMAA.
ui_scale (doc 23): the size of the whole interface, shown on Settings' Interface tab
(its section). auto follows the display scale Windows sets for the screen, as the
largest of the steps not above it. A step is offered only while it leaves the
interface at least 960 x 540 to lay out in; a choice too large for the window waits
at the largest step that fits.

settings.title: Display
settings.about: Borderless fills the screen as a window; Fullscreen takes it over.

settings.title: Render scale
settings.about: Below 100%, the world is upscaled with FSR; the interface stays sharp.

settings.title: Frame rate
settings.about: Even shares of your {refresh} Hz screen keep panning smooth.

settings.title: VSync
settings.about: Waits for the screen, so frames never tear.

settings.title: Shadows
settings.about: Sun and firelight shadows; lower is blurrier and faster.

settings.title: Anti-aliasing
settings.about: Smooths the jagged edges of blocks.

settings.title: UI scale
settings.about: Every button, window and card. The world keeps its full resolution.
